item.title: U.S. officials look to Europe to learn how to make prison better
item.description: American prison officials are looking to European nations like Germany and Norway for a roadmap on how to design a prison that emphasizes rehabilitation and a successful return to life on the outside.

item.title: AI hoaxes are deceiving 911 dispatchers, and they're only getting harder to detect
item.description: Swatters are increasingly using AI technology that creates synthetic voices or sound effects to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls to law enforcement.

item.title: Federal government failed to hold Epstein accountable, Republican committee says
item.description: The Republican chair of the House Oversight Committee released a scathing report after a 15-month investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. It faulted the federal government with decades of failing to hold Epstein accountable.

item.description: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.
